title: Owari no Seraph: Owaranai Seraph
justification: AniList: 9 shorts of 2 min, 2015-06-24 to 2015-09-26 "Owaranai Seraph". AniDB 10813 S1-S9 "Owaranai Seraph 1-9" on 2015-06-24 x4, 07-23, 08-26 x2, 09-26 x2; S10 "The Beginning of the End" (2015-10-03) is the recap and S11-S13 are undated interviews, not in the run. TVDB 289906 season 0 0x1-0x9 "Seraph of the Endless 1-9" on the same dates, then 0x10 "The Beginning of the End (Recap)" = S10. Parent has no mapping list (overlay/10813.json only unmaps S12 and S13), so S<n> defaults to 0x<n>; 11809 starts at 0x11, 10984 is on season 1.
